name: io.github.mguttmann/the-real-hetzner-mcp
title: Hetzner Cloud (unofficial)
description: Unofficial MCP server for the Hetzner Cloud API: one typed tool per operation, read and write.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_API_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Hetzner Cloud API token from the Cloud Console (project > Security > API tokens). The server can do exactly what this token allows; use a Read token if the client only needs to read.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: true: every tool that is not read-only, and hcloud_raw_request with a method other than GET, returns an error without sending a request. Any value other than true, 1, yes, false, 0, no or empty stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_CONFIRM_WRITES
environmentVariables.description: true: every tool that is not read-only returns a preview unless the call carries confirm "YES". Friction against mistakes, not a security boundary.

environmentVariables.name: HETZNER_DENY_TOOLS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated tool name globs (for example hcloud_delete_*,hcloud_raw_request) that always return an error. Deny hcloud_raw_request as well, otherwise denied endpoints stay reachable through it. A pattern that matches no tool stops the server at startup.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level of the JSON logs on stderr.
